svg.aria-label: Kelp — Personal project · in progress. Run Kubernetes without ever touching kubectl or YAML. You create containers in a visual interface, wire them together by pulling cables, and Kelp sets up the cluster, namespaces and deployments behind the scenes. Stack: Spring Boot, Fabric8, docker-java, WebSocket, DDD.
